cases.label: Case finding
cases.goal: Find what fails in real chats, by kind, and freeze the cases each round runs

questions.label: Case finder
questions.brief: Mines real chats for failing and passing cases and writes a script check for each

arms.label: Bench
arms.goal: Make the arms so every round runs the same way, each proven on one case

bench.label: Bench keeper
bench.brief: Builds each arm (worktree, test copy or variant) and proves it runs one case

fix.label: Fix
fix.goal: After each round, say whether it can still improve and what next; on your go-ahead, one change per arm, the fewest words, committed as an experiment

consultant.label: Consultant
consultant.brief: A strong model that reads each round's failing replies, sends a short outlook, then on your go-ahead proposes exactly one change

builder.label: Builder
builder.brief: Applies the proposal exactly as written and commits it as an experiment

run.label: Run
run.goal: Run every case on every test model in every arm, never swapping a test model

runner.label: Runner
runner.brief: Runs the round's cases on one test model with the runner script, then takes the screenshots

grade.label: Grading
grade.goal: Judge the replies no script can check, without knowing which arm made them

grader.label: Grader
grader.brief: Grades blind, against each case's expectation alone

review.label: Landing review
review.goal: Decide, independently of the campaign, whether the winner is good enough to land

reviewer.label: Landing reviewer
reviewer.brief: Has no part in the campaign, reads the last outlook, and gives Land, Another cycle, Park or Baseline kept with evidence

steps.label: Find what fails, in real chats
Build the bench and freeze the cases
Baseline on master, once; its outlook follows
asks: every consultant's outlook says further changes are futile

repeat.carry: The winner becomes the next cycle's base and the losing change is reverted; master stays Round 0 in every chart.

steps.label: Consultant picks one change, builder commits it
Run every test model on every arm
Score and chart the round; its outlook follows
asks: every consultant's outlook says further changes are futile

steps.label: Is it good enough to land?
Land, cycle again, park or keep the baseline

questions.ask: What fails today, and in which chats?
What is measured, and how: a script check per case, a blind grader, or both?
Which record does this campaign continue? List the project's records (the files in .sova/ab/) and recommend one, or a new short name such as vis.
